_comment: CA001 - Require MFA for all users. Applies to: the Halden Microsoft Entra ID tenant (P2, lab only). Excludes the two monitored break-glass accounts, which must always be able to sign in with a password alone. Deployed by projects/p02-identity-lifecycle/scripts/07-New-ConditionalAccessPolicies.ps1, report-only first. The token __BREAKGLASS_UPNS__ is replaced at deploy time with the real break-glass UPNs passed to the script; no tenant values are stored in this repository.
